newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Boxed beef continues to ease and packers holding down bids for fed.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Index turned back up, corn futures called lower and interest rates easing.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Pork cutout down and live seen steady to lower. But hog runs remain light.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Product lower again Tuesday but may be near bottom. Out-of-town neutral.
